operation.summary: Cancel a pending approver recovery: the agent that started it withdraws it at once; anyone else's cancel asks a listed approver for the owner's check; explicit owner.configuration grant required
operation.returns: state (none|pending|cancelled|cleared), started_by, started_at, clear_at, time_left_ms, ended_by, ended_at, can_start, blocked_reason (not_available|owner_email_required|no_approver), remaining_human_step when a listed approver has to confirm

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
